newsitem.title: UK: UK's DTI says receives advice on Bass deal.
newsitem.headline: UK's DTI says receives advice on Bass deal.

text.p: Britain's Department of Trade and Industry said it has received advice from the Office of Fair Trading on a proposed 200 million stg acquisition of Carlsberg-Tetley by British brewer Bass.
"I cannot tell you what that advice is, I'm afraid that is market sensitive," said a DTI spokesman.
It is now for Trade and Industry Secretary Ian Lang to decide whether or not to block the deal. But the DTI spokesman could not say how long a decision would take.
"There are two arms to the merger, one between C-T and Bass where Bass takes 50 percent and that is subject to a statutory deadline of December 25," he said.

"The other is a full takeover of C-T including the acquisition of Carlsberg Tetley A/S which has no statutory deadline. But we would expect both parts of the merger to be looked at together and an announcement about both will be made at the same time," he added.
